commands.purpose: Replay committed Studio changes in one workspace-wide order.

input_schema.revision: required integer for undo or redo
input_schema.tx_id: required ID from the current undo or redo entry

preconditions: Selected timeline workspace and matching scope.
Replay requires the current journal revision, transaction ID and native editor state.
state_changes: Records new Studio Timeline, Story DAG, form graph, notebook and act-structure changes.
Undo or redo updates the native editor and journal together.
A new edit discards the project redo sequence.

result_schema.changed: transaction returned by a successful step

error_cases: Stale journal or editor revision, unavailable workspace data, or unsafe cross-file journal mode.
commands.undo_policy: Append or replay native revisions using the recorded patch references. Existing dedicated editor histories remain available.
commands.persistence_policy: SQLite project order and immutable patch references. Forms and timeline use an attached transaction in rollback-journal mode.
commands.cancellation_policy: Any replay failure rolls back the transaction.
commands.ui_binding: Studio header Undo and Redo, Ctrl+Z and Ctrl+Shift+Z. Editable fields retain text shortcuts.
commands.automation_binding: POST /api/episode-command with the history action and payload.

commands.purpose: Use a scoped Noir workspace and its shared reference readers from another local process.
preconditions: Selected existing timeline and local library; trusted private v1 ticket bound to the workspace and port.
Writing start requires an explicitly enabled writer, stable request ID and hard attempt and byte ceilings.
state_changes: Read commands and previews never spend writer attempts.
Run start or explicit resume uses the native run store and the shared durable budget; generated variants stay separate from the manuscript.
Draft apply, notebook history, Timeline changes, and source intake use revision-checked episode commands.
error_cases: 403 unauthenticated or cross-origin
404 unlisted action or protocol
400 stale revisions, unconfigured writer or invalid limits
503 unavailable service or workspace
commands.undo_policy: Proposal generation does not edit the manuscript; notebook.undo and notebook.redo reverse a saved application through EpisodeCommands.
commands.persistence_policy: SQLite stores run and draft revisions and durable per-ticket call counts. Reconnecting never starts a run.
commands.cancellation_policy: Explicit run.cancel; an unresolved send remains counted and is not retried or redirected to another session.
commands.ui_binding: Native Timeline, variant Full Graph and the Studio Processing dock. Connected Noir Workbench uses the shared service; standalone Workbench uses file histories.
commands.automation_binding: tools.noir_client:NoirClient; /v1/status, /v1/episodes, /v1/open, /v1/command, /v1/cover, /v1/intake and /v1/scope.

commands.purpose: Validate and apply a typed action to canonical in-memory state.
preconditions: Transaction references configured entities and action type; action preconditions come from current world state.
state_changes: Only a valid transaction updates the corresponding character, room, portal, prop or posture fluents.
error_cases: Unknown entity or action; locked/unreachable route; unavailable prop; invalid affordance.
commands.undo_policy: Use the graph snapshot/replay workflow for recovery; no general end-user undo command.
commands.persistence_policy: In-memory operation; callers own persistence.
commands.cancellation_policy: Synchronous; cancel before invoking.
commands.revision_precondition: No external revision check; caller supplies current state.
commands.idempotency_policy: Stateful action; do not automatically retry.
commands.ui_binding: No direct Studio transition binding asserted.
commands.automation_binding: Python engine and scenario sequencer

commands.purpose: Project an executed story beat into a typed BeatPacket.
preconditions: Executed beat record and matching snapshot for historical compilation.
state_changes: Compilation does not advance the story. Explicit export writes only the chosen artifact.
error_cases: Missing or malformed beat record; export destination I/O error.
commands.undo_policy: Recompile from retained input; keep prior export as a separate artifact.
commands.persistence_policy: Packet in memory unless an explicit export runs.
commands.cancellation_policy: Synchronous; cancel before export.
commands.ui_binding: Studio graph display is not proof that live Compute compiles this packet.
commands.automation_binding: Python API, hybrid pipeline and dedicated tools/check_mo2.py replay.

commands.purpose: Generate review proposals, or apply an explicitly reviewed request to the revision store.
preconditions: Input is readable, provider is configured, and protected dialogue stays frozen by default.
Use a separate output directory; external data transfer follows project permissions.
state_changes: Without --apply writes proposal artifacts. With --apply, checks the original source and dispatches an explicit reviewed request.
error_cases: Provider failure or rejected candidate; known gap: CLI writes before reporting document-wide issues.
A reference preflight failure returns a rejected proposal without calling a provider; a post-response scoring error retains a rejected candidate.
commands.undo_policy: Discard the generated copy and use the original; no revision-level undo.
commands.persistence_policy: Local artifacts and telemetry; no approved master update.
commands.cancellation_policy: No persisted cancel/restart contract. Treat interrupted output as incomplete.
commands.revision_precondition: Uses current invocation input; no persisted apply compare-and-swap.
commands.idempotency_policy: Do not retry automatically; output and telemetry can be rewritten/appended.
commands.ui_binding: Workbench and Studio do not use the same validated apply service yet.
commands.automation_binding: python -m prose_engine condition
commands.nr03_change: Scoped Studio, Workbench timeline mode and CLI share operation dispatch; standalone routes are labeled unscoped. Three direct reference tools now use shared purpose/influence policy. Scoped CLI accepts --form-store and sibling character-forms.sqlite; standalone routes and local scoring gaps remain.

commands.purpose: Generate and rank alternative treatments of an author-directed beat.
preconditions: Valid action paragraph; dialogue frozen; configured provider and author direction.
state_changes: Returns proposal alternatives; optional report only. No author-approved state change.
error_cases: Bad paragraph or locked dialogue; budget/provider error; staging and embedding fallback gaps tracked separately.
commands.undo_policy: Discard the proposals.
commands.persistence_policy: Optional variation report; no manuscript write.
commands.cancellation_policy: Provider budget may stop generation; persistent cancellation is not implemented.
commands.coverage_note: tests.test_voice_variations covers legacy treatment and deduplication behavior; exact voice vary failure paths need separate fixtures.
commands.ui_binding: Workbench variation uses a separate path.
commands.automation_binding: python -m prose_engine voice vary

commands.purpose: Preview Studio's current demo transformations on supplied blocks.
preconditions: Local Studio; valid JSON block payload.
state_changes: Returns unchanged blocks and diagnostic score; no proposals are generated or committed.
error_cases: Legacy analyzer does not perform reviewed editing; use the reviewed editorial route.
commands.undo_policy: Dismiss or reset the preview.
commands.persistence_policy: No on-disk commit by this endpoint.
commands.cancellation_policy: No server-side cancel contract.
commands.ui_binding: Studio Compute button
commands.automation_binding: POST /api/compute (loopback demo only)

commands.purpose: Preview, commit or undo explicit reviewed changes to a configured revision store.
preconditions: Workbench has accepted edits and a separate writable output directory.
state_changes: Preview is read-only. Apply and undo use the shared revision store.
error_cases: No edits means no save; two separate writes can partially succeed; no stale-input or whole-document commit check.
commands.undo_policy: Keep the original and discard the incomplete or unwanted exports.
commands.persistence_policy: Local files only; does not establish named author acceptance.
commands.cancellation_policy: Synchronous; cancel before save.
commands.coverage_note: Revision, stale edit and partial write behavior remain unverified.
commands.ui_binding: Workbench Preview changes, Accept and apply, Undo revision
commands.automation_binding: Workbench.save

commands.purpose: Extract a permitted local book and update its text and manifest entry.
preconditions: Readable supported text/PDF/EPUB source; permissions permit local ingestion.
state_changes: Writes text and manifest; index rebuild is a separate operation.
error_cases: Unsupported/empty input or extraction failure; write interruption can leave text and manifest out of sync.
commands.undo_policy: Recover prior text and manifest from a verified checkpoint; do not delete the source.
commands.persistence_policy: Local extracted text and manifest. No automatic remote upload.
commands.cancellation_policy: No atomic batch cancellation; inspect partial results.
commands.ui_binding: No Studio ingest binding verified.
commands.automation_binding: tools/book_ingest.py and tools/book_finder.py ingest

commands.purpose: Run the declared static architecture check and established local fixture suite.
preconditions: Python project dependencies available; loopback allowed and Studio fixture port 8795 free.
state_changes: No intentional project asset writes; fixtures use temporary work and a loopback test server.
error_cases: Undeclared static import, bad map or source parse, fixture failure, baseline below 78, timeout.
commands.undo_policy: Not applicable to a read-only project check.
commands.persistence_policy: Console results; attach reviewed output and working-tree fingerprint to the task. No auto-acceptance.
commands.cancellation_policy: CI limits architecture to 120 seconds and core fixtures to 240 seconds; interrupted results do not pass.
commands.ui_binding: None
commands.automation_binding: python -B tools/ci.py --core

commands.purpose: Validate candidate edits in memory for author review.
preconditions: Caller supplies exact Unicode code-point ranges, frozen spans and a loaded world state.
error_cases: Stale revision, invalid or overlapping range, frozen span, new canon occurrence.
commands.undo_policy: No state is committed.
commands.persistence_policy: No file or telemetry writes.
commands.cancellation_policy: Synchronous in-memory evaluation.
commands.ui_binding: UNWIRED (U3)
commands.automation_binding: Python API

commands.purpose: Commit explicitly reviewed and revalidated edits to a separate transactional revision store.
preconditions: Store was explicitly created at a new local path; caller supplies the protected ranges and records a named review.
state_changes: One atomic database transaction commits text, decision, and revision head.
error_cases: Stale revision, changed world or candidate, frozen text, new canon issue, reused operation ID with different data, failed storage.
commands.undo_policy: Undo records an inverse revision restoring the prior text and protected ranges.
commands.persistence_policy: Separate SQLite database; exclusive creation. No original manuscript write. Export creates a new file without overwriting.
commands.cancellation_policy: Uncommitted transactions roll back; retries with the same ID and payload return the recorded result.
commands.ui_binding: Studio Reviewed edits when launched with --review-store
commands.automation_binding: Python API and python -m prose_engine editorial

commands.purpose: Replay the source-anchored 20-beat graph and validate structured claims against a beat snapshot.
preconditions: Local source and scenario definitions; claims must match the recorded world snapshot.
state_changes: Read-only replay. An explicit manifest destination creates a new file.
error_cases: Invalid or stale claim, illegal transition, inaccessible store, or existing output.
commands.undo_policy: Replay from the retained scenario; retain earlier manifests.
commands.persistence_policy: Explicit export only; source and manuscript are read-only.
commands.cancellation_policy: Cancel before creating an output file.
commands.ui_binding: Studio story view uses the same replayed form availability.
commands.automation_binding: python -B tools/check_mo2.py

commands.purpose: Save separate appearance boards, connect typed Mind data, stage episode forms, and edit directed relationship cues.
preconditions: Loopback Studio with a local form store; valid port and typed target; current graph revision.
state_changes: Saves the selected port, new data node or named stage only. Does not activate any story form.
A new character graph and per-form image references are stored with the graph; existing known image paths remain source-linked.
Save or undo a node position for one character without changing story state.

Save a JSON object independently on a valid character junction, form port, or connected data port; saved Personality, Voice, Notes and structured_data fields project as universal_author context only for base, beat-active and linked active/base nodes (inactive forms remain withheld via hidden phrases and changes invalidate drafts via character_store_token).

Node files (up to 20 MB each) are stored as blobs with hash-checked, node-owned metadata (and excluded from scoped prompts). A revision-checked graph journal records before/after states, including attachment metadata.
Save private board notes and card positions by existing form port. The server refuses card positions referencing another form's file. Create and link a typed mind in a single graph change.
error_cases: Stale revision, unregistered target, invalid stage, or unavailable store.
Invalid or oversized node content, invalid node for that character, stale graph revision, or no node history to undo.
commands.undo_policy: Graph-wide Undo/Redo reverses journaled graph actions; node details and positions also have their own recovery controls. Attachment blobs are retained for restore; a new graph change clears the redo stack.
commands.persistence_policy: Local SQLite transaction with revision checking.
commands.cancellation_policy: Leave the selection unsaved or close the map before saving.
commands.ui_binding: Studio v2 > Graph > Character Junctions > Board. The legacy UI uses the same store but has no board surface.
commands.automation_binding: GET or same-origin POST /api/form-graph; replay and prose_engine scoped can read the store with --form-store or sibling character-forms.sqlite.
commands.character_block_change: Studio and NotebookStore append-block require an existing graph identity for newly added character blocks. Existing source blocks are preserved; other legacy editing paths are outside this contract.
commands.character_graph_view: Cytoscape projects Multi-Character Overview (All characters) and single-character views with a left roster, 3-field node cards (Personality, Voice, Notes and port indicators) and saved data connections. Rainee normal and Peter retain distinct existing port IDs; historical imported forms remain separately accessible. Node positions are revision-checked and persisted per character; planning visualization does not activate a form, while inspector Scoped Generation Context status reports active/base inclusion vs inactive withholding.

commands.purpose: Freeze a local author pilot and score named blinded decisions separately from automated eligibility.
preconditions: Pinned manuscript and exact edit anchors; named decisions and matching fingerprint for reporting.
state_changes: Build creates a local review pack and gate receipt; report reads decisions and prints metrics only.
error_cases: Source drift, stale or duplicate decisions, missing reviewer, insufficient eligible cases or existing destination.
commands.undo_policy: Change a saved vote and export a fresh decisions file. No source edits occur.
commands.persistence_policy: Review page can export and import portable decision files; local pairing key stays separate.
commands.cancellation_policy: Stop at any case; resume from saved progress.
commands.ui_binding: Standalone local author review page.
commands.automation_binding: python -B tools/review_pilot.py build or report

commands.purpose: Measure local, edition-scoped reference ranking without using the production library or editing the manuscript.
preconditions: Original frozen fixture; pinned local safetensors snapshots and an unused output filename.
state_changes: Creates only the explicitly requested ID-only report; index and manuscript are read-only.
error_cases: Invalid or out-of-scope fixture, missing model files, insufficient CUDA memory, wrong-edition results, or output exists.
commands.undo_policy: Use a new report path for another run; no production mutation occurs.
commands.persistence_policy: Scratch index is in memory; model files are pinned in the local cache.
commands.cancellation_policy: Interrupt before the report is written; reuse the same pinned inputs to rerun.
commands.ui_binding: None; opt-in evaluation tool.
commands.automation_binding: python -B tools/run_retrieval_u6.py

commands.purpose: Compare offline coprocessors on frozen local spans and validate proposals for the primary Codex or Gemini session.
preconditions: Frozen protocol and exact source fingerprints; local model and runtime where required; unused output directory.
state_changes: Creates only the specified report directory; a GGUF child listens on loopback and requires a per-run key for requests.
error_cases: Input drift, missing or mismatched weights, insufficient GPU headroom, invalid proposals or runtime/timeout errors.
commands.undo_policy: No manuscript or index writes. Keep prior evidence and use a new report directory for a rerun.
commands.persistence_policy: Keep generated spans and runtime logs in ignored local storage. Publish only aggregate evidence.
commands.cancellation_policy: Test disconnect of a streaming GGUF request and confirm slot release. Interrupting the trial shuts down the child; the current adapter has no per-request cancellation.
commands.ui_binding: None; opt-in local evaluation tool.
commands.automation_binding: python -B tools/run_local_u7.py

preconditions: The output directory must not already exist.
commands.ui_binding: None; opt-in local tool.
commands.cancellation_policy: Stop the local command; retain any incomplete output and use a new destination.
commands.purpose: Build an application-code-only local wheel.
state_changes: Creates the explicitly named output directory and wheel.
error_cases: Existing output, missing build tools, unexpected wheel contents or timeout.
commands.undo_policy: No existing destination is overwritten.
commands.persistence_policy: Local output only; no publication.
commands.automation_binding: python -B tools/u8_package.py --out <new-directory>

preconditions: The output directory must not already exist.
commands.ui_binding: None; opt-in local tool.
commands.cancellation_policy: Stop the local command; retain any incomplete output and use a new destination.
commands.purpose: Create and restore a SQLite-aware editorial checkpoint and compare revision history.
state_changes: Reads an existing revision store and creates checkpoint and restored copies in a new directory.
error_cases: Existing output, source drift, invalid store, integrity failure or timeout.
commands.undo_policy: No source or existing destination is overwritten.
commands.persistence_policy: The new local directory holds the checkpoint, restored copy and receipt.
commands.automation_binding: python -B tools/u8_recovery.py --source <store> --out <new-directory>

commands.purpose: Create a local fingerprint of application code without overwriting existing manifests.
preconditions: An unused output filename and readable application source.
state_changes: Creates only the explicitly named code-only manifest.
error_cases: Existing output or unreadable application source.
commands.undo_policy: No existing manifest is overwritten.
commands.persistence_policy: Local output only; no publication.
commands.cancellation_policy: Retain any incomplete output; retry with a fresh filename.
commands.ui_binding: None; opt-in local tool.
commands.automation_binding: python -B tools/manifest.py --out <new-file>

commands.purpose: Reserve session attempts before dispatch, persist responses and reconcile outcomes.
preconditions: Use one writable journal per session configuration; use a stable job_id when resuming the same job.
state_changes: A committed reservation consumes budget before the handler is invoked.
Concurrent pending attempts in the same provider/scope are blocked.
Successful session responses and their UTF-8 SHA-256 commit with the outcome before returning to the caller.
error_cases: Budget exhausted, unavailable journal, failed response, remote outcome unknown.
commands.undo_policy: Attempts are retained and never refunded. Reconcile only after checking the outcome.
commands.persistence_policy: SQLite beside the local usage receipt; no prompt or response content. JSONL is an optional compatibility receipt.
commands.cancellation_policy: Cancel requested is not confirmed cancellation; the operator records cancellation only after transport confirmation.
commands.ui_binding: Studio scoped generation; reports unresolved attempt ID. Existing standalone session consumers share the same provider class.
commands.automation_binding: Session provider factory and prose_engine session-attempts.

commands.purpose: Produce timeline-scoped proposals and validate exact protected spans.
preconditions: Select a current revision and nonempty code-point range; generation requires met timeline prerequisites.
state_changes: Explicit scoped generation writes a draft attempt record; apply-draft can append a checked notebook and episode revision. Other scoped inspection operations do not change manuscript text.
error_cases: Stale scope or invalid ranges; omitted or altered protected text; provider errors. Semantic review remains necessary.
commands.undo_policy: Applying a draft can be undone by appending a notebook revision; draft history remains preserved.
commands.persistence_policy: Explicit generation persists a scoped draft and candidate outcome in the episode timeline database; prior manuscript revisions remain intact.
commands.cancellation_policy: Scoped session requests use the attempt journal; absence of a result is not proof of remote cancellation.
commands.ui_binding: Studio supports native single-block selection, cross-block Shift-click, preview selection or marked cursor ranges and whole-episode generation. Notebook masks determine protection; without a notebook, legacy dialogue protection applies.
commands.automation_binding: prose_engine scoped; --protected-ranges accepts absolute code-point pairs; --form-store reads FormGraphStore (or auto-resolves sibling character-forms.sqlite).
commands.nr01_change: Scoped timeline operations bind project/universe identity and snapshot law revision; legacy database migration creates a separate copy. Standalone routes remain unscoped.
commands.nr02_change: Scoped structured constraints and claims are source-linked, branch/interval-aware and conservative about beliefs and quotations; automated prose extraction and complete typed-law editing are not implemented.
commands.nr03_change: Scoped Studio, Workbench timeline mode and CLI share operation dispatch; standalone routes are labeled unscoped. Three direct reference tools now use shared purpose/influence policy. Scoped CLI accepts --form-store and sibling character-forms.sqlite; standalone routes and local scoring gaps remain.
commands.nr04_change: Scoped generation may opt into purpose/influence-filtered book references; episode scope resolves before ranking, text-free draft receipts and source-setting fingerprint rechecks are retained. No-reference mode remains explicit.
commands.nr05_change: Scoped packets combine author-supplied CharacterProfileStore snapshots and FormGraphStore node_data (Personality, Voice, Notes, structured_data) for base, beat-active and linked active/base nodes. Private/future/inactive form text is withheld (including >=8-char hidden-phrase checks); character_store_token invalidates drafts, while uploaded node attachment blobs remain outside generation.
commands.nr06_change: Scoped generation resolves the selected beat rhythm revision and author direction, with optional bounded cadence observations from eligible references; stale selected-beat drafts are rejected.
commands.nr07_change: New episode drafts retain scoped writing context, provider budget and attempt identity. Completed, blocked and stale returned candidates are recoverable; application rechecks reference binding as well as existing scope and protection.
commands.nr08_change: Validation and recorded drafts include source-linked, rule-based meaning findings with supported, contradicted, uncertain or unavailable status. No match verifies the entire passage; a labeled development set documents misses.
commands.nr09_change: The episode composer shares Racing/Classic theme tokens and a revision-bound selection preview and cursor endpoints for cross-block protection and scoped actions. Cross-block edits preserve uniquely mapped block boundaries or reject ambiguous replacements.
commands.nr09c_change: Cross-block selection additionally supports Shift-click with stale selection reset. TimelineStore.save refuses text or source changes for existing notebooks even if its legacy opt-out argument is false; notebook service performs checked atomic saves. Direct database writes remain outside this guard.
commands.nr09d_change: Studio uses a selection-adjacent 25/50/75/100 protection popup and document default popup, calling the same revision-checked notebook save without generation; inactive stale masks can be reviewed in the Highlighter menu and dismissed in #maskPopover (#maskStaleSection / dismiss-stale) without un-hiding raw controls. Timeline shows persisted covers, revision-checked same-branch reordering, and an episode-scoped draft drawer; freeform positioning and zoom remain unimplemented.
commands.nr09e_change: Racing uses the supplied track animation in protection and during explicit scoped generation. Studio, /timeline and /world-laws honor ?theme=racing|classic query overrides without changing saved preferences, and /racing-comparison?mode=themes compares live Racing and Classic composers side-by-side. Timeline creates empty episodes from a title with automatic identity and placement (using create+move fallback when placing before an existing tight slot), supports revision-checked same-branch reordering (TimelineStore.move_episode), and double-clicking a cover updates artwork only after checking episode head and prior cover. Old artwork is retained internally; no restore UI yet.
commands.nr09f_change: Racing displays distinct original track animation frames for saved document or effective selection weights, plays the source frames on interaction, and hides Racing imagery in Classic. Mixed and unavailable selections have no single weight. The checked protection service remains authoritative.
commands.nr09h_change: Four source-derived GIFs play once from empty to their corresponding 25/50/75/100 protection frame and stop; the Racing control plays the matching GIF and retains its saved frame.
commands.nr09g_change: Studio exposes an author-focused split writing/episode-graph and beat direction workspace, a Prose Engine panel, a separate World Laws page and a simple Highlighter menu. Raw protection controls are hidden; exact soft masks can be removed and inactive stale masks dismissed in the popup, and drafts remain in Prose Engine. Block-identity editing still uses existing controls. Existing checked storage and reference eligibility remain authoritative; automatic document-to-graph intake is not yet implemented.
commands.nr09i_change: Racing writing-block text, speaker labels and line-number typography are reduced by 50 percent, with matching highlight and measurement metrics; Classic and notebook data remain unchanged.
commands.nr11_change: Fully 100-percent notebook-protected selections must match their original text exactly, including boundaries. Studio grouped passages use separate scoped calls, eligible references and a checked aggregate draft; automatic passage timing remains unverified and uses beat zero.

commands.purpose: Filter author-selected source rows before reference ranking, inspection, prompt transfer or export.
preconditions: Reference policy and source metadata must be available for requested purposes.
state_changes: Derived filtered index views only; no source or existing index is rewritten.
error_cases: Unconfigured, corrupt or denied sources do not enter covered routes. Legacy rank IDs cannot be uniquely mapped without the original receipt.
Configured retrieval that is missing, corrupt, or has no eligible sources reports its status and does not silently fall back.
commands.undo_policy: Configuration is author-controlled; existing source and index artifacts are preserved.
commands.persistence_policy: Policy file is explicit; existing index metadata is not silently migrated.
commands.cancellation_policy: Local retrieval is synchronous.
commands.ui_binding: Workbench and scoped Studio use shared policy-aware retrieval. Studio availability reports all three indexes without constructing an encoder; quality-held sources are visibly excluded.
commands.automation_binding: CLI conditioner, variants generation, local scoring, reference inspection and passage export use shared purpose-specific policy.
commands.nr03_change: Scoped Studio, Workbench timeline mode and CLI share operation dispatch; standalone routes are labeled unscoped. Three direct reference tools now use shared purpose/influence policy. Scoped CLI accepts --form-store and sibling character-forms.sqlite; standalone routes and local scoring gaps remain.
commands.nr04_change: Scoped generation may opt into purpose/influence-filtered book references; episode scope resolves before ranking, text-free draft receipts and source-setting fingerprint rechecks are retained. No-reference mode remains explicit.
commands.noir_lib_001_change: Quality exclusions independently fence retained suspect sources at policy/corpus load. Normal selectors use the atomically selected three-index release; old indexes are retained only for recovery/history after activation. Batch setup preserves existing author entries and does not grant export. Explicitly requested standalone variant references fail closed if unavailable.

commands.purpose: Retain source revisions and rank-independent passage identity, including explicit legacy index position IDs.
preconditions: Reference policy and source metadata must be available for requested purposes.
state_changes: Derived filtered index views only; no source or existing index is rewritten.
error_cases: Unconfigured, corrupt or denied sources do not enter covered routes. Legacy rank IDs cannot be uniquely mapped without the original receipt.
commands.undo_policy: Configuration is author-controlled; existing source and index artifacts are preserved.
commands.persistence_policy: New source revisions and ordinals; legacy index-position IDs preserve existing index files. Receipt mapping is explicit and ambiguous duplicates require an anchor.
commands.cancellation_policy: Local retrieval is synchronous.
commands.ui_binding: Workbench exposes retrieval status; visual source configuration remains planned.
commands.automation_binding: Condition, generate-variants, variants, reference and corpus passages CLI paths.

commands.purpose: Score bounded labeled pairs locally and evaluate a LUAR similarity-drop threshold on document-disjoint held-out data.
preconditions: Local LUAR index and explicitly permitted rank_local reference sources for scoring.
Labeled pairs identify documents, split, decisions and evidence.
state_changes: Explicit new score and report files only; no provider requests and no change to live thresholds.
error_cases: Missing policy or index, unverified or invalid scores, overlapping document splits, too few examples, existing output paths and changed source configuration.
commands.undo_policy: Inputs and existing outputs are untouched; explicitly created local outputs can be removed by their owner.
commands.persistence_policy: Score output omits original and candidate text; pipeline, source-policy and influence hashes accompany numeric scores.
commands.cancellation_policy: Local scoring is bounded to 60 pairs; no remote requests or automatic retries.
commands.ui_binding: CLI only; user-facing calibration controls remain future work.
commands.automation_binding: python -B tools/score_luar_calibration.py; python -B tools/calibrate_luar.py

commands.purpose: Inventory reference index provenance and reject incompatible versioned LUAR or style models.
preconditions: Existing indexes are trusted local files; a new LUAR index needs a locally cached pinned model.
state_changes: Audit reads indexes and writes only a new explicitly named report. New indexes are separate artifacts; existing indexes are not overwritten by save_new.
error_cases: Encoder, runtime, source-index, chunk hash or style-model mismatch; missing source or legacy manifest remains explicitly unverified.
commands.undo_policy: Keep old indexes and select the prior artifact; no automatic migration or replacement.
commands.persistence_policy: Versioned LUAR index records source hash, chunk hashes, model revision, preprocessing and runtime.
commands.cancellation_policy: Local operations only; no provider request.
commands.ui_binding: Studio identifies legacy indexes as incomplete; versioned readiness verifies saved bytes, source coverage, runtime, encoder/model and normalization bindings without loading an encoder.
commands.automation_binding: tools/audit_reference_indexes.py; Python index builders and loaders.
commands.noir_lib_001_change: Separate pinned offline candidates are reloaded and probed per source before atomic-pointer activation. Original canonical files are never overwritten; code/model/source drift, incomplete coverage and failed probes block activation. See tools/library_rebuild.py and tests.test_library_indexes.

commands.purpose: Versioned episode-scoped blocks with source anchors and optimistic revisions.
preconditions: Episode and expected revisions must match; preserve existing hard locks.
state_changes: Transactional episode-scoped records; provider calls occur only on explicit generation.
error_cases: Stale revisions or anchors, wrong branch, exact freezes, and incomplete provider outcomes fail closed.
commands.undo_policy: Revision-checked Undo and Redo append restored states as new revisions. Separate persistent stacks preserve redo after reload; a new edit clears redo.
commands.persistence_policy: SQLite timeline store; source and earlier revisions preserved.
commands.cancellation_policy: No automatic retries; incomplete generation remains recorded.
commands.ui_binding: Studio Racing and Classic editor groups consecutive Narrator or same-speaker/form passages into continuous auto-sized full-height blocks with one header while inline protection popups, cross-block Shift-click, cursor markers and More tools remain active.
commands.automation_binding: Shared Python service, Studio scoped route, and scoped CLI generation.
commands.nr07_change: New episode drafts retain scoped writing context, provider budget and attempt identity. Completed, blocked and stale returned candidates are recoverable; application rechecks reference binding as well as existing scope and protection.
commands.nr09_change: The episode composer shares Racing/Classic theme tokens and a revision-bound selection preview and cursor endpoints for cross-block protection and scoped actions. Cross-block edits preserve uniquely mapped block boundaries or reject ambiguous replacements.

commands.purpose: Inspect accumulative canon state and Pass 0-3 findings against saved episodes or draft text, queue detected delta proposals, and review/resolve/retire canon proposals in Studio.

input_schema.POST /api/canon-diff: JSON {episode?, branch?, episode_position?, beat?, viewpoint?, source_origin?, text?, blocks?, queue_proposals?, project?, universe?}
input_schema.POST /api/canon-proposals: JSON {action: 'open'|'list'|'propose'|'resolve'|'retire_delta', project?, universe?, episode?, branch?, episode_position?, beat?, status?, kind?, payload?, rationale?, proposal_id?, decision?, reviewer?, delta_id?, retired?}

commands.preconditions: Same-origin HTTP header Origin == http://127.0.0.1:<port>, Content-Type application/json, Content-Length <= 1,000,000; allowed in both standalone and timeline_only Studio server modes.
commands.state_changes: /api/canon-diff modifies canon_proposals only when queue_proposals=True inside BEGIN IMMEDIATE; /api/canon-proposals writes pending proposals, commits accepted deltas/laws/traits on resolve, or toggles state_deltas.retired on retire_delta.

result_schema.POST /api/canon-diff: 200 JSON {coord, state_digest, spans_count, claims, findings, conflicts, warnings, advisories, uncertain, supported, queued_proposals, relationships, characters}
result_schema.POST /api/canon-proposals: 200 JSON action-specific payload ({proposals, state_digest, coord, relationships} | {proposal_id, status} | resolve receipt | {delta_id, retired})

error_cases: 403 PermissionError on foreign Origin header
400 ValueError/KeyError/sqlite3.Error on oversized/invalid JSON, missing required fields, unknown proposal action, or unknown delta_id
commands.undo_policy: Accepted proposals are never destructively erased; operators invert applied timeline deltas via POST /api/canon-proposals action='retire_delta'.
commands.persistence_policy: Backed by the active workspace timeline SQLite database via BEGIN IMMEDIATE transactions after verify_scope.
commands.cancellation_policy: Request-scoped synchronous SQLite transactions; failed validation rolls back before commit.
commands.ui_binding: Studio World Laws & Canon panel (#v2CanonAuditBtn, #v2CanonRefreshBtn, #v2CanonQueueChk, [data-canon-resolve]) in tools/assets/v2/prose.js and v2 world_law graph node.
commands.automation_binding: Same-origin POST /api/canon-diff and POST /api/canon-proposals

commands.purpose: Extract clip expressive envelopes and pause windows via prose_engine.media_analysis with opt-in evidence context gating; enforce physiological_emission/sensory_propagation laws, BeatPacket complement epistemic_unknown checks, and MindProjectionResolver multi-body/InteractionRule validation.

input_schema.Evidence.context: () -> {kind, source, timecode, revision, reviewer, text} (requires permission == 'permitted' and non-empty reviewer + reviewed)
input_schema.MindProjectionResolver.active_bodies: (junctions, replay_frame?, beat_overrides?, active_relationships?, interaction_rules?, active_pressures?) -> List[MindProjection]

commands.preconditions: Offline WAV pause extraction requires valid 16-bit PCM WAV; CUDA CLAP/Whisper/ECAPA paths require local HF snapshots and opt-in flag; Evidence.context() refuses unpermitted or unreviewed rows.
commands.state_changes: Pure analysis/validation helper calls have no persistent world mutation; BeatPacketCompiler attaches epistemic_unknown complement per active character from EpistemicLedger.get_unknown_facts.

result_schema.ClipExpressiveEnvelope: {schema_version, duration_sec, pause_windows, speech_segments, clap_mood_tags, speaker_embedding_dim, speech_rate_wps, errors}
result_schema.MindProjection: {character_id, form_id, node_id, location, speaker_label, provenance_layers, active_rules, traits, relationships}

error_cases: PermissionError on Evidence.context() without permission == 'permitted' or reviewer/reviewed annotation
ValueError on unknown world-law kind in story_graph.typed_laws.validate_constraint
commands.undo_policy: Evidence JSON sidecars remain inspectable on disk; world-law edits use existing canon proposal retirement.
commands.persistence_policy: Evidence JSON persisted via save_evidence/load_evidence when explicitly invoked; analysis envelopes and BeatPackets are in-memory artifacts.
commands.cancellation_policy: Deterministic local WAV RMS and rule checks complete synchronously in-memory.
commands.ui_binding: Studio Graph v2 media_clip, mind_state, character_switchyard, and world_law nodes in tools/assets/v2/graph_engine.js

commands.purpose: Partition target passages across 0/25/50/75/100% protection tiers with exact duplicate-occurrence coordinates, splice occurrence-safe slot fills, validate structural seams and tier fidelity, and expose non-mutating preview/validation via prose_engine.scoped_pipeline and Studio POST /api/slot-infill.

input_schema.validate_infill_seams: (plan, assembled_text, source_edit?, slot_segments?, enforce_tier_fidelity?, allow_empty?) -> SeamValidationReport
input_schema.POST /api/slot-infill: JSON {action: 'plan'|'validate'|'preview', episode?, branch?, revision?, beat?, viewpoint?, start?, end?, protection_ranges?, default_tier?, source_text?, fills?, candidate_text?, source_edit?, enforce_tier_fidelity?, allow_empty?}

commands.preconditions: Same-origin Origin == http://127.0.0.1:<port>, Content-Type application/json, Content-Length <= 1,000,000 for HTTP POST /api/slot-infill; slot tiers must be integers in 0..100 on Unicode grapheme-safe offsets.
commands.state_changes: Pure read-only inspection and non-mutating validation/preview; never modifies timeline revisions, notebook revisions, or episode scripts on disk.

result_schema.InfillPlan: {base_offset, source_sha256, default_tier, slot_count, editable_count, locked_count, slots}
result_schema.POST /api/slot-infill: 200 JSON ({action, plan} | {action, valid, issues, text, source_edit?, candidate_bounds?, applied_slots?, validation, plan})

error_cases: 403 PermissionError on foreign Origin header
400 ValueError on ambiguous duplicate occurrence string reference, attempt to edit a 100% locked slot, grapheme-splitting boundary, tier violation, or seam defect
commands.undo_policy: Read-only planning and fill validation leave saved manuscript revisions untouched; approved edits still go through revision-checked notebook/draft apply.
commands.persistence_policy: Stateless per-request planning and validation over saved timeline/notebook state or supplied standalone source_text.
commands.cancellation_policy: Synchronous in-memory evaluation; rejected fills never write partial changes.
commands.ui_binding: Studio same-origin POST /api/slot-infill over Studio v2 Compose protection masks (#composeContainer / NotebookStore)
commands.automation_binding: Direct Python APIs prose_engine.slot_infill.{plan_infill_slots,apply_slot_fills,validate_infill_seams}, prose_engine.scoped_pipeline.{build_infill_plan,evaluate_infill_proposal}, and POST /api/slot-infill

commands.purpose: Compile <=6144-byte UTF-8 De Novo CraftBriefs, critique prose deterministically via SlopCritic (exempting quotes and valid negations), and rank dialogue- & canon-valid candidates with BestOfN.

input_schema.compile_craft_brief: (scene_heading, beats, skeleton?, lens_id?, viewpoint?, world_laws?, mind_directives?, epistemic_withheld?, craft_cues?, max_bytes?, seed?) -> CraftBrief
input_schema.DeNovoSynthesizer.synthesize_best_of_n: (provider, scene_heading, beats, skeleton?, n?, reference_text?, margin?, packet?, infill_plan?, mind_projections?, seeds?) -> dict
input_schema.POST /api/craft-brief: JSON {action: 'compile'|'critique'|'rank', episode?, branch?, revision?, beat?, viewpoint?, start?, end?, source_text?, text?, candidates?, beats?, scene_heading?, lens_id?, world_laws?, mind_directives?, epistemic_withheld?, craft_cues?, max_bytes?, use_saved_model?, require_burstiness?, margin?}

commands.preconditions: Same-origin Origin == http://127.0.0.1:<port>, Content-Type application/json, Content-Length <= 1,000,000 for HTTP POST /api/craft-brief; max_bytes must be within 512..6144.
commands.state_changes: Pure read-only brief compilation, slop critique, and candidate ranking; never modifies episodes or canon tables on disk.

result_schema.CraftBrief: {scene_heading, lens_id, viewpoint, max_bytes, byte_size, brief_sha256, trimmed_sections, prompt}
result_schema.SlopCritique: {passed, slop_score, quality_bonus, hard_blocks, warnings, spans, anti_ai_issues, cliches, burstiness, burstiness_passed, model_used}
result_schema.synthesize_best_of_n: {status: 'PROPOSED'|'BLOCKED', winner, alternatives, candidates, rejected, critic_reports, brief, issues}

error_cases: 403 PermissionError on foreign Origin header
400 ValueError on out-of-range max_bytes, empty candidates list for rank, unknown action, or invalid scope
commands.undo_policy: Stateless compilation and ranking; candidate adoption still passes through checked DraftStore/NotebookStore apply.
commands.persistence_policy: In-memory evaluation over saved episode scope or supplied text.
commands.cancellation_policy: Synchronous evaluation with hard per-brief UTF-8 byte ceiling (6144 bytes).
commands.ui_binding: Studio same-origin POST /api/craft-brief in tools/studio_canon_routes.py
commands.automation_binding: prose_engine.voice.synthesizer.{compile_craft_brief,DeNovoSynthesizer}, prose_engine.voice.slop_critic.SlopCritic, prose_engine.voice.best_of_n, and POST /api/craft-brief
